readerCopy.headline: A small opening can change who has leverage.
readerCopy.body:
A negotiation gets reopened. Someone with authority backs a change you could not make alone. One part of an agreement that used to be untouchable becomes negotiable. You may not need to win the whole battle. One better term can change what the rest of the arrangement costs you.

Jupiter sextile Pluto can make a strategic change possible without a full confrontation. Use the opening to improve the part that matters most. Better access, clearer authority, or one removed obligation may do more than a dramatic show of power ever would.
doNotAssume: Do not assume a financial windfall, authority figure, inheritance, or conflict.
